questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to others drivers.
Come to a full stop and proceed when it is safe.
Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and remain stopped while the red arrow is activated.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must stop completely. Stay stopped until the red arrow disappears.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow signs warn of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you the road is slippery when wet. Slow down when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools. It warns you to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Begin to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red eight-sided sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns. You cannot legally turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs alert drivers to school zones. These signs warn of school crosswalks where children and pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to other traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a construction flagger ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles or red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs indicate you are at or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot legally turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending ahead. You will need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians crossing your path pass. Stop if necessary before going ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: A round sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Turns in the direction shown by the arrow are not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and other roads where entry is not allowed. You may see it on expressway ramps where you are trying to enter the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that the divided highway is ending. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to upcoming conditions. It tells you to prepare for traffic merging from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Adjust your speed to avoid collisions and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade or hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a divided highway beginning. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You cannot make a U-turn at this location. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to areas where bicycles, people, and animals may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to the upcoming curve. The speed plaque shows the safe speed to use. Slow down to 35 mph or less for the curve ahead.
